notes: Observed OSM classifications; not an official tourism approval or a popularity ranking. Lodging is excluded.
Individual timestamp is the last OSM element edit, not current business operation or visitor observation.
Way/relation coordinate is element bbox center, not a validated entrance or guaranteed interior point.
Natural peaks/volcanoes/cave entrances carry a conservative access-point flag; this is not a verified closure or travel restriction.
Public opening_hours/fee/access tags are preserved as community observations; current opening, price, road access and conditions are not verified.
No forced identity merging with Hub1349 or the food snapshot; distinct OSM identities remain distinct.
One fixed Jeju bbox query; no user GPS or personal preferences transmitted.
ODbL attribution and share-alike apply to this derived database.
